args.body:
**Decision needed: the 3% increase hit fixed-price contract products.**
- The catalog check shows that the 3% increase I applied on 2026-10-14 also covered 22 products marked FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT (P-1201 to P-1222). They were meant to be excluded.
- Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.
- I haven't changed anything yet. I couldn't pull the original prices from the price history, so I haven't confirmed the revert values.
- Recommended: (1) approve me to revert the 22 products to their pre-10-14 prices, which I'll check against the price history first. (2) Have someone in billing or sales ops correct or credit the 8 orders and decide how to contact the affected customers. I won't contact customers myself.
Please confirm (1) and I'll proceed.
